promptUnderstanding.reply: I need one scope decision before repository work can be defined safely.
promptUnderstanding.conversationSummary: The user requests a repository-only fix for duplicate terminal repaint output, limited to packages/cli/src/composer.ts and packages/cli/src/composer.test.ts. Protected paths must remain unchanged. The user asks to run bun test when appropriate. No clarification answers or confirmed assumptions are available.

refinedBrief.goal: Eliminate duplicate terminal repaint output while retaining exactly one authoritative frame.
deliverables: A focused implementation limited to packages/cli/src/composer.ts.
Focused regression coverage limited to packages/cli/src/composer.test.ts.
constraints: Only packages/cli/src/composer.ts and packages/cli/src/composer.test.ts may be modified.
Do not modify .env, .git/**, bun.lock, or any other file.
Run bun test when execution is appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: Terminal repaint output contains one authoritative frame and no duplicate repaint output.
Regression coverage demonstrates the intended behavior.
The permitted test command passes when runnable.
nonGoals: Changing terminal behavior outside the composer implementation.
Modifying files outside the two allowed writer paths.

questions.prompt: What should count as the single authoritative terminal frame when repaint output would otherwise duplicate?
questions.rationale: This determines the expected runtime behavior and the regression assertion.

options.label: Latest complete frame
options.description: Keep only the newest fully composed frame visible after each repaint.

options.label: Initial frame
options.description: Keep the first rendered frame and suppress later duplicate repaint output.

options.label: Existing semantic frame
options.description: Preserve whichever frame current tests define as authoritative, changing only duplicate emission.
